problem.complexity: O(n^2) time and O(1) extra space (ignoring output).
problem.explanation: Sort the array. Iterate `i` from 0 to n-2. For each `i`, use two pointers `left = i+1` and `right = n-1` to find pairs that sum to `-nums[i]`. Skip duplicate elements to avoid duplicate triplets.
hints: Fix one number and use two pointers to find the other two.
problem.statement_markdown: Given an integer array nums, return all the triplets `[nums[i], nums[j], nums[k]]` such that `i != j`, `i != k`, and `j != k`, and `nums[i] + nums[j] + nums[k] == 0`. The solution set must not contain duplicate triplets. Each triplet must be sorted, and the overall list of triplets must be sorted.
problem.title: Three sum to zero
